institution.name: Institute for Quantum Computing, University of Waterloo

qualifications: Aimed at undergraduate students; students finishing their undergraduate degree right before the program may apply if they have not started a graduate program
International students are only considered if they also apply for a summer research Undergraduate Research Award (URA)
description_short: The Institute for Quantum Computing at the University of Waterloo, Canada, holds its Undergraduate School on Experimental Quantum Information Processing (USEQIP) from 31 May to 11 June 2027. Applications (CV, cover letter, unofficial transcript, one reference) are due 3 January 2027.

deadline.evidence_quote: Applications for USEQIP are due Sunday, January 3, 2027. Late applications will not be considered.
